in_sanskrit.name: प्रभाति

in_marathi.name: Prabhati
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prabhati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Prabhata’ which means dawn or radiant. Prabhati is a name for a girl, evoking the spirit of a new beginning, hope, and a fresh start.

in_bengali.name: Prabhati
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Dawn, radiant
